questions.question: Rikham pada dance belongs to which of the following states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rikham Pada** dance is a traditional dance form of the state of **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• This dance is performed by the **Nyishi tribe**, which is one of the largest ethnic groups in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• The dance is usually performed during the **Nyokum festival**, which is celebrated to invoke the blessings of the gods for a good harvest and well-being of the people.
 
• Performers of the Rikham Pada dance wear traditional attire and adorn themselves with colorful ornaments.
 
• The dance is characterized by its rhythmic movements and is accompanied by traditional music played on indigenous instruments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is known for its rich cultural heritage and diverse ethnic groups, each with its own unique traditions and festivals.
 
• The state is located in the northeastern part of India and **shares international borders with Bhutan, China, and Myanmar**.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is also known for its scenic beauty, with lush green forests, rivers, and mountains.
 
• The state's cultural festivals, including the Nyokum festival, play a significant role in preserving and promoting the traditional arts and customs of its various tribes.
 
• Other notable festivals in Arunachal Pradesh include **Losar, Dree, and Solung**, each celebrated by different ethnic communities.

questions.question: How many classical dance forms does the Sangeet Natak Akademi in India officially recognise, as of August 2021?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Eight dance forms have been acknowledged by Sangeet Natak Akademi as classical dance forms of India as of **August 2021.**

 
 
• The classical dance form originated from the** Natya Shastra.**
 
• Classical dance has a deep-rooted relationship with the** Natya Shastra where the specific features of each of the Classical dance forms have been mentioned.**
 
• There are 8 classical dance forms in India as per the source and scholars:
 
 
• Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Kathakali, Sattriya, Manipuri and Mohiniyattam. 
 
 
 
• The Cultural Ministry of India has included Chhau in the list of classical dances make a total of** 9 classical dance forms.**
 
• The 8 basic technicalities that are expressed in classical dance are given below:
 
 
• Shringar: Love
 
• Hasya: Humorous
 
• Karuna: Sorrow
 
• Raudra: Anger
 
• Veer: Heroism
 
• Bhayanak: Fear
 
• Bibhats: Disgust
 
• Adbhoot: Wonder
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In India, dance forms can be broadly classified into** 2 categories:**

 
 
• classical and folk dance form
 
 
 
• These dance forms have been originated from different parts of India as per the local tradition.
 
• Folk dance, on the other hand, emerged from the local tradition of the respective state, ethnic or geographic regions.

questions.question: Teejan Bai was awarded a Padma Bhushan for her art in 2003. She is a great exponent of which dance form?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandavani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Teejan Bai:-**

 
 
• **She is a renowned Pandavani singer from Chhattisgarh, India.**
 
• Pandavani is a traditional folk art form in which stories from the Mahabharata are narrated with musical accompaniment. 
 
• Teejan Bai is known as the first female exponent of Pandavani. 
 
• Teejan Bai learned Pandavani singing from her maternal grandfather, Brijlal Pardhi, who was a renowned Pandavani artist.
 
• Teejan Bai listened to and memorized Mahabharata stories from her grandfather from a young age.
 
• She started singing Pandavani at the age of 13. She soon impressed people with her talent and won several awards, including the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Ghoomar:-**

 
 
• **It is a traditional folk dance of Rajasthan, India. **
 
• It is primarily performed by women, who wear a veil and a flowing dress called a ghaghara.
 
• The dance begins with slow movements that gradually become faster, and the dancers' veils flutter in the air. During the dance, the dancers often move their hands and feet in delicate and graceful movements.
 
 
 
• **Kalbelia:-**
 
 
• **It is a folk dance form of the Kalbelia people, a snake-charming tribe from the Thar Desert in Rajasthan, India. **
 
• The dance is an integral part of their culture and performed by men and women.
 
 
 
• **Chhau dance:-**
 
 
• **It is a semi-classical Indian dance form with martial and folk traditions. **
 
• It is found in three styles named after the location where they are performed: the Purulia Chhau of West Bengal, the Seraikella Chhau of Jharkhand, and the Mayurbhanj Chhau of Odisha.

questions.question: Kuchipudi dance is accompanied by which type of music?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Carnatic.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kuchipudi dance** is a** classical dance** form from** Andhra Pradesh, India.**
 
• It is accompanied by **Carnatic music**, which is a classical music form from South India.
 
• Carnatic music is known for its **rhythmic complexity **and** melodious compositions.**
 
• The instruments commonly used in Kuchipudi dance performances are **mridangam, veena, flute, and violin.**
 
• Fusion, Hindustani, and Jazz music are** not** traditionally associated with Kuchipudi dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fusion music** is a blend of **different music styles,** such as Indian classical, Western classical, jazz, and rock.
 
• **Hindustani music** is a classical music form from **North India** and is known for its improvisation and use of **ragas.**
 
• **Jazz** music originated in **African American communities** in the United States and is characterized by **improvisation, swing rhythms, and bluesy notes.**

• Her work has been instrumental in ensuring that the rich heritage of Bharatanatyam continues to inspire newer generations.
